title: Recording audio repair
description: Scan older recordings and normalize eligible audio to AAC-LC, 48 kHz stereo without re-encoding the video. A scan never changes footage.
safety: Eligible originals are backed up before repair. Protected evidence, archived files, and recordings without audio are not rewritten. Missing audio cannot be recovered. Normalization does not add browser video-codec support or guarantee audio playback in every browser.
scanOnly: Scan first, review the list, then explicitly start selected repairs. Large libraries are processed in the background.
invalidFilters: Enter a valid date range and a scan limit between 1 and 10,000.
selectionLimit: Select up to 500 recordings, or explicitly start all eligible recordings.
requestFailed: The audio repair request failed. Refresh the job status before retrying a write.
noJobs: No audio repair scans have been started.
controlHelp: Pause takes effect at a safe file boundary. Stop cancels unfinished work; completed repairs and their backups remain. Jobs do not resume automatically after a restart.

status.scanning: Scanning recordings. No files are being changed.
status.ready: Scan complete. Review the list and choose which recordings to repair.
status.running: Repairing audio. Original video is preserved.
status.pause_requested: Pausing at the next safe boundary.
status.interrupted: Interrupted by a restart. Review the job before continuing.

reason.no-audio: No audio track exists to repair.
reason.already-compatible: Audio is already in the target format.
reason.not-completed: The recording is too recent or incomplete.
reason.outside-recordings: The file is outside the managed recordings directory.
reason.source-changed: The recording changed during the operation.
reason.inspection-failed: The recording could not be inspected.
reason.camera-not-configured: The recording's camera is no longer configured.

list.selectPage: Select eligible recordings on this page

confirm.title: Start audio repair?
confirm.description: Only eligible recordings will be changed. The original files are backed up and their video bitstreams are verified unchanged. Stopping later does not undo completed repairs. Make sure there is enough free space for the backups.
